digest.component_or_area: create coordination and outbound dispatch routing
propositions: Process restart must converge to exactly one remote issue and one confirmed binding without duplicates across crash-restart sequences

Create dispatch is governed by a single selector (create_route.create_route) with COORDINATOR_ROUTE default and LEGACY_ROUTE rollback, ensuring no dual-send across three live consumers (route_for, reroute_migrated_plans, handle_create)
Dependent links and children must be held until proven create and binding confirmation are complete, while tombstones and filters remain effective
Keyed recovery performs zero search; keyless recovery requires both three misses and 3600 seconds elapsed time
Per-entry recovery failure must not block unrelated ticket processing

The coordinated create core must preserve exact contract behavior (return create dict on confirmed, re-raise original exception on failure, emit BRIDGE_ALERT on landed-unconfirmed, defer on commit-unknown)
